Sub: Audio Recording of Conference Call pertaining to the Financial Performance for the quarter

Dear Sir / Madam,  
 
In continuation of our earlier letter dated November 13, 2025 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part 
A of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, please find below the link to the audio recording of the 
Conference call with Investors and Analysts on the operational and financial performance of the Company 
for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2025, held today on Friday, November 14, 2025. 
 
https://www.balajitelefilms.com/pdf/BalajiQ2FY26.mp3  
 
The Financial Results were approved by the Board at its Meeting held on Thursday, November 13, 2025. 
 
Kindly take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours truly, 
 
For Balaji Telefilms Limited
